```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(httr2)
library(purrr)
```

```{r}
imdb_snapshots <- read_rds("data/imdb_snapshots.rds")

imdb_snapshots

imdb_snapshots |>
  count(snap_year)
```

```{r}
#| eval: false
urls <- c(
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20150101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20170101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20190101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20210101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20220201012049/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/"
)

snap_years <- c(2015, 2017, 2019, 2021, 2022)

scrape_snapshot <- function(url, snap_year) {
  html <- request(url) |>
    req_user_agent("r4ds-student-project") |>
    req_throttle(rate = 30 / 60) |>
    req_retry(max_tries = 3, retry_on_failure = TRUE) |>
    req_perform() |>
    resp_body_html()

  tibble(
    snap_year = snap_year,
    rank = html |>
      html_elements("td.titleColumn") |>
      html_text2() |>
      str_extract("^\\d+") |>
      as.integer(),
    title = html |>
      html_elements("td.titleColumn a") |>
      html_text2(),
    year = html |>
      html_elements("td.titleColumn span.secondaryInfo") |>
      html_text2() |>
      str_extract("\\d{4}") |>
      as.integer(),
    rating = html |>
      html_elements("td.imdbRating strong") |>
      html_text2() |>
      as.numeric(),
    number = html |>
      html_elements("td.imdbRating strong") |>
      html_attr("title") |>
      str_extract("(?<=based on )[0-9,]+") |>
      parse_number()
  )
}

imdb_snapshots <- map2(urls, snap_years, scrape_snapshot) |>
  list_rbind()
```

```{r}
rank_changes <- imdb_snapshots |>
  filter(snap_year %in% c(2015, 2022)) |>
  select(title, year, snap_year, rank) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = snap_year,
    values_from = rank,
    names_prefix = "rank_"
  ) |>
  drop_na(rank_2015, rank_2022) |>
  mutate(
    rank_change = rank_2015 - rank_2022,
    decade = (year %/% 10) * 10
  )

rank_changes |>
  slice_max(abs(rank_change), n = 10)
```

```{r}
rank_changes |>
  summarize(
    avg_rank_change = mean(rank_change),
    n_films = n(),
    .by = decade
  ) |>
  arrange(decade)
```

```{r}
film_counts <- imdb_snapshots |>
  count(title, year, name = "n_snapshots")

film_counts |>
  count(n_snapshots, name = "n_films")
```

```{r}
rank_changes |>
  summarize(
    avg_rank_change = mean(rank_change),
    .by = decade
  ) |>
  arrange(decade) |>
  mutate(
    decade_label = fct_inorder(paste0(decade, "s")),
    direction = if_else(avg_rank_change > 0, "Rose", "Fell")
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = avg_rank_change, y = decade_label, fill = direction)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray30") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Fell" = "#d95f02", "Rose" = "#1b9e77")) +
  labs(
    title = "Older Films Lost Ground on the IMDb Top 250 (2015–2022)",
    subtitle = "Only 1990s films rose on average, while 1930s and 1940s classics dropped over 30 spots",
    x = "Average Rank Change (Positive = Rose Toward #1)",
    y = "Release Decade",
    fill = "Rank Direction",
    caption = "Source: IMDb Top 250 via Wayback Machine (190 films appearing in both 2015 and 2022 snapshots)."
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
